## Summary

The IEEE registry lists 34 MA-L blocks to "SAMSUNG ELECTRO-MECHANICS(THAILAND)" at a Wellgrow Industrial Estate address in Bangpakong, Chachoengsao, Thailand (a few rows carry a US country code by mistake) [1]. Its parent is Samsung Electro-Mechanics, a Samsung Group subsidiary headquartered in Suwon, South Korea, established in 1973 as Samsung Sanyo Parts, which makes multi-layer ceramic capacitors and camera and network modules for telecommunications and lists Thailand among its overseas locations [2]. Samsung Electro-Mechanics' own location page now lists its Southeast Asian production in the Philippines and Vietnam and no Thai site, so the Thai operation may no longer be active under that name [3].

What a MAC in these blocks is cannot be said from the sources consulted: no product, module, radio, silicon or FCC grantee code is documented for the Thai unit [2][3]. The FCC ID databases were not reachable from the session that wrote this entry, and nothing is filled in from memory.
